g.text: Training Sequence - From UI Click To Persisted QLearning Artifacts
instead of this runner. That path is inference-only:
no Q-value updates and no repository writes.
TrainingController.stop() sets an Event that is checked before each
episode and while paused. The current requestStop/clearStop attribute
checks use snake_case names, so they do not reach QLearningBot's
camelCase hooks during an in-flight episode.
